topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Rain’s been pouring down since before the sun came up, and the streets are a mirror of the city's grimmest thoughts. I'm sitting in my office, the neon signs flickering outside, when the door slams open and a gust of damp air follows a man in a cheap trench coat. He’s got a gadget in his hands, a thing he swears can change the world. But there's a catch, always a catch. Turns out, some sharp-suited character filed the patent months ago. Now, he’s here, looking for a way to fight it, to reclaim what he believes is rightfully his. I listen, pour another drink, and I start to see the angles. This town, it’s full of lost causes and second chances, and maybe, just maybe, there’s a way to turn the lights back on for this one, too.
